nh15e13.title: The seating chart
nh15e13.caption: Libra tried three seats for its date: next to the baby photos, beside the loudest laugh in the house, and across from a toy drum. Option four was obvious all along. Who did you get seated next to last year?

nh15e14.title: So what do you do?
nh15e14.caption: Virgo answered the uncle with a full slide deck. What actually worked was soup. Turns out the question was never a test, just a door. What do you say when a relative asks what you do?

nh15e15.title: The kids' table
nh15e15.caption: Sagittarius got sent to the kids' table and won the crayon finals. Aries lasted one round of weather talk before squeezing into the tiniest chair. Which table are you picking this year?

nh15e16.title: The photo
nh15e16.caption: Take one, Scorpio stepped out of frame. Take two, Leo found its good side and nobody else fit. Take three is the one going on the fridge. Who is always half out of your family photo?

nh15e17.title: The gift you forgot
nh15e17.caption: Aquarius forgot the gift, tried a wrapped spoon, then a pinecone with a bow, then just told the truth and fixed Grandma's lamp. Best present in the room. What's the best gift you got that wasn't a thing?

nh15e18.title: The game that got too competitive
nh15e18.caption: Round one was friendly. By round three there was a strategy binder, three notepads and two cousins hiding under the table, and Grandma still won. Who gets too competitive at your game night?

nh15e19.title: Cooking together
nh15e19.caption: Taurus tasted everything, Cancer followed the recipe card to the letter, and the flour went everywhere. Grandma's last line fixed it. In the kitchen, are you the taster or the measurer?

nh15e20.title: The quiet walk after dinner
nh15e20.caption: The house hit max volume, so Scorpio and Pisces went for a walk under Orion and finally said the nervous part out loud. Pisces cried, obviously. Where do you have your best talks?

nh15e21.title: The call to a friend who stayed in town
nh15e21.caption: Virgo called the friend who stayed in the city, the whole family crowded in to wave, and Grandma had questions about dinner. A plate is officially saved. Who are you calling this holiday?
